stories.title: Babar Azam returns to form with a century in domestic final
stories.summary: The batter played a patient innings to lift his side to a comfortable win. Coaches said the knock should ease selection worries.

stories.title: Fakhar Zaman eyes one last shot at World Cup glory
stories.summary: Fakhar Zaman knows exactly how it feels to win major trophies. He also knows how it feels to wait years for that feeling.

stories.title: Medvedev sees off Paul to set up Shanghai semi with comeback king Jodar
stories.summary: Former world number one Daniil Medvedev downed Tommy Paul 6-3, 1-6, 6-3 in the Shanghai Masters quarter-finals on Friday, while Spaniard Rafael Jodar toppled Casper Ruud 4-6, 6-4, 6-3 to become the youngest semi-finalist in the tournament’s history.

stories.title: Iga Swiatek moves into Wuhan Open semi-finals
stories.summary: Iga Swiatek kept up her bid for a WTA Finals place with a 6-4, 6-1 victory over Ann Li on Friday that set up an all-Polish semi-final at the Wuhan Open. The six-time Grand Slam champion will face Maja Chwalinska for a place in the final.

stories.title: PSL franchises debate new player draft rules
stories.summary: Team owners met to discuss changes to the PSL player draft. A final decision is expected before the next season.

stories.title: Premier League title race tightens after a late winner
stories.summary: A stoppage-time goal cut the gap at the top of the Premier League table. The leaders face a tough away trip next.

stories.title: 'I had so many medals under the bed' - Green on Chelsea success
stories.summary: When Paul Green left Chelsea after 13 years, he had achieved so much success that the majority of his medals were hidden away in a box under the bed.

stories.title: Matos on tactics, Klopp's influence, and taking Swans to top of the league
stories.summary: Swansea boss Vitor Matos spent five years as an elite development coach at Liverpool, but it would be unfair to paint him with a Jurgen Klopp-shaped brush entirely.

stories.summary: A new report says hospital networks are facing more frequent cyber attacks. Experts urge basic fixes such as software updates and backups.

stories.title: Pope's health should not be taken 'for granted', says top Vatican diplomat
stories.summary: Archbishop Paul Gallagher tells the BBC there was no sign of the Pope's ill health prior to his operation this week.

stories.summary: Shares rose after the company said demand for AI chips remains high. Investors are watching supply limits closely.

stories.summary: The 16-year-old suspect previously attended the primary school and had targeted a special educational needs classroom, police say.
